content:
Using the maximum possible angle sum with exactly 4 obtuse angles:

\[
\text{sum} < 4(180^\circ) + (n-4)(90^\circ)
\]

The required sum is:

\[
(n-2)180^\circ
\]

Thus,

\[
(n-2)180 < 720 + (n-4)90
\]

\[
180n - 360 < 90n + 360
\]

\[
90n < 720
\]

\[
n < 8
\]

So \(n \le 7\). This is achievable, for example with four \(157.5^\circ\) angles and three \(90^\circ\) angles.

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
